description: Analyse clips for cuts in their footage (Clip > Scene Edit Detection, without the dialog) and add an edit, a clip marker or a subclip at each cut. Runs on the given clips or the Timeline selection; the selection is replaced by those clips. Analysis can continue after the call returns: waitSeconds waits for it

clips.description: The clips to analyse (items from list_clips, or selected: true)

items.description: A clip in the sequence, as list_clips reports it

clipIndex.description: Clip index on the track, 0 = first

selected.description: Include the clips selected in the Timeline

operation.description: cut: Apply a cut at each scene edit; marker: Generate clip markers; subclip: Create subclips in the project. Default cut

sequence.description: Which sequence. Give its name or guid (from list_sequences); omit for the active sequence

waitSeconds.description: Wait up to this long for the analysis to finish. Default 0. Raise PREMIERE_SCRIPT_TIMEOUT_MS for long waits

name: run_scene_edit_detection
title: Run Scene Edit Detection
